cardObtain: [Unidentified] Defeat this monster in Hollow Zero 1 time to obtain its data
cardQuote: —Words from a graying combat mechanic, left upon retirement
cardSkillDesc: In combat, when Miasmic - Heavy Striker deploys its shield, it activates a small Miasmic Field. If Miasmic - Lightfoot Rover is also on the field, the two will carry out coordinated attacks. Additionally, when Miasmic - Lightfoot Rover is close to death, Miasmic - Heavy Striker will leap toward the target due to coordinated combat signal interference, seize its combat data core, acquire Miasmic - Lightfoot Rover's drones and abilities, and command the drones to fight alongside it.
desc:
This autonomous tactical mech, swallowed by the Hollow, has grown even more brutal after corruption, powerful enough to crush Goblins with ease.
Once a steadfast shield protecting soldiers against devastating attacks, the Defense Force's most trusted companion has now transformed into a terrifying killing machine.
"If you have the courage, then grant our once-reliable friend a final end, freeing it from the sins and shattered honor it now carries."
name: Miasmic - Heavy Striker
